subject: Private offer drawdown sequencing & co-sell handoff – CloudForge
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Kunal Das <kunal@kp-digital.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. The CloudForge procurement team reviewed the Private Offer term sheet and wants to confirm the drawdown sequencing — specifically how monthly invoice triggers align with committed SKU burn and whether we can front-load any credits into Q4 to match our usage ramp.

Two quick asks: 1) can you share the proposed drawdown schedule in an editable sheet, and 2) what does the co-sell handoff look like between Redwood field sales and Google post-acceptance (we'll need the channel contacts for market planning).

Kunal from our integrations team is copied — he may have a couple of technical questions for the Marketplace listing.

Appreciate your help,

Marta Alvarez
Head of Cloud Procurement, CloudForge

(attachment: CF_PO_Questions.pdf)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Hi Marta —

Thanks for the clear asks. We'll get a draft drawdown schedule over to you today and outline the co-sell handoff path. High-level answers up front:

- Drawdown: we typically align invoice triggers to monthly SKU consumption with a small buffer month to month; we can front-load 25% of committed credits into Q4 on request, but that changes the later-month billing cadence — I'll surface exact permutations in the sheet.
- Co-sell handoff: Redwood coordinates a 30-day post-acceptance GTM plan with the Partner Engineer + Field AE copied into the marketplace acceptance email. For CloudForge we'll propose a joint webinar + solution brief in the first 60 days.

I'm attaching a workbook with 3 templated sequencing options (steady burn, front-loaded Q4, and ramp-then-level). Ben and Lauren — can you validate the invoicing language and legal-friendly phrasing for the term sheet before I send the package to Marta?

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

(attachments: CF_commit_schedule_v3.xlsx, draft_seq_readme.txt)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-20T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Thanks, Jasmine — reviewed. A few clarifying points from finance/legal:

- If CloudForge opts for the 25% Q4 front-load, invoices will still be issued monthly but the committed balance will decrement faster; we can provide a billing waterfall report each invoice cycle.
- We need to lock final SKU mapping before acceptance; I marked the SKU rows in the sheet where we need CloudForge confirmation.
- Term sheet redline: change section 3.2 to say "billing adjustments may be applied up to 45 days post-invoice" (legal wants this window).

Marta — attaching a redlined PDF of the term sheet for quick review. If that window is acceptable, we can proceed to DocuSign.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
(attachment: Private_Offer_Term_Sheet_redline.pdf)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-21T10:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Hi Marta —

Happy to jump on the co-sell planning. Suggested immediate next steps:

1) Acceptance checklist: finalize SKUs + sign PO (we can draft the DocuSign envelope once legal confirms redline).
2) GTM: proposed co-sell plan doc (I will circulate) with kickoff call week of Nov 2.
3) Tracking: Redwood will share a shared sheet (drive link below) to track lead registration and crediting for the marketplace.

Lauren — please confirm the Google partner contacts (PE and Partner Sales Manager) so we can include them on the kickoff invite.

Marta — is Nov 3 at 10am PT a viable time for the kickoff? If not, propose two alternatives and we'll lock it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Co-sell & GTM, Redwood Inference

(related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GTM-plan-CloudForge)

From: Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Kunal Das <kunal@kp-digital.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-21T13:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Hi Marissa / Jasmine —

Nov 3 at 10am PT works for our execs. One quick procurement question before we lock: how does front-loading affect the timing of invoiceable milestones for our internal cost center? We need the invoice calendar to align with our quarter close (we prefer invoices in late Nov / Dec rather than early Jan). If you can map the invoice dates in the workbook that will help approval.

Also adding Kunal here for the GTM kickoff — he wants to review a short list of integration proof points we'd highlight during joint enablement.

I'll wait for the DocuSign when legal confirms redline.

Best,
Marta

(attachment: approval_checklist.docx)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@cloudforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-22T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning on private-offer drawdown cadence and co-sell

Hi Marta —

Great — locking Nov 3 10am PT for the kickoff. Per your ask, I've attached the finalized schedule options and highlighted the invoice dates for the front-load scenario (sheet tab: "FrontLoad_InvoiceDates"). Key notes:

- If front-load 25%: invoices will be generated on Nov 30, Dec 31, then monthly thereafter based on usage; front-load will reduce the Jan/Feb invoice amounts.
- We can move the invoice issue date up to Nov 25 if CloudForge needs earlier posting for quarter close — that requires legal signoff but finance confirmed it's feasible.

Ben will start the DocuSign envelope once we have the final redline confirmation — Ben, can you expedite once Marta confirms section 3.2?

See attachments: Private_Offer_Term_Sheet.pdf, CF_commit_schedule_v3.xlsx

Thanks everyone — talk on Nov 3.

—Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
(attachments: Private_Offer_Term_Sheet.pdf, CF_commit_schedule_v3.xlsx)
